notes: Source is Lenovo's own PSREF (Product Specifications Reference) datasheet for "ThinkSmart Core for Microsoft Team Rooms" (dated Oct 16 2024), the base compute-puck SKU behind the ThinkSmart Core conferencing bundle. PSREF currently flags this line "(Withdrawn)" — it has been succeeded by ThinkSmart Core Gen 2, a different product with a different port layout (2x USB-C 10Gbps w/ DP 1.4, 3x USB-A 5Gbps, HDMI 2.1, etc.) — do not conflate the two. The 11 ports listed are the "Rear Ports" table explicitly scoped to "Compute System (ThinkSmart Core) only" (separate from the ThinkSmart Controller / Audio Bar / Cam accessory ports, which are not part of this device). USB generation-to-speed mapping (Gen1=5Gbps, Gen2=10Gbps, Thunderbolt 4=40Gbps) and Gigabit Ethernet (Intel I219-LM) are explicitly confirmed in the datasheet's connectivity notes. HDMI-in's version and the power connector's exact physical geometry are not stated by Lenovo (see per-port notes). Desktop/tabletop unit (226 x 200 x 37.5 mm, 1.1 kg) — no rack mounting, so rackUnits omitted. Same physical compute unit (with identical I/O) is also sold in "ThinkSmart Core for Zoom" and "ThinkSmart Core for Logitech" bundles per Lenovo's parallel PSREF sheets.

ports.name: HDMI-in
ports.note: Only present on selected models per Lenovo footnote; HDMI version not separately stated in the datasheet (unlike the two versioned HDMI-out 1.4 ports), so grade omitted rather than assumed.

ports.name: Power connector
ports.note: Datasheet only labels this 'Power connector', powered by an external 90W autosensing adapter; exact barrel/pin geometry not specified by Lenovo, mapped to closest available connector id.
